purpose: Bind diagnostic scorer-threshold sweeps to explicit evidence semantics and prevent an exploratory threshold from becoming a production operating point by accident.

threshold_semantics.meaning: minimum p_irrelevant required before a scorer suggestion may be converted into a hypothetical reduction

declared_thresholds.note: default conservative control; currently produces zero removal on value fixtures
measured hypothetical reduction on synthetic fixtures; not a production threshold
allowed only for boundary exploration on synthetic fixtures

conditions: unsupported and unresolved requests bypass before scoring

selection_rule.rule: A future production trial threshold may only be proposed on a declared development cohort before held-out review. It must preserve every protected-family veto condition, and the observed outcome data from evaluation-only fixtures must not be used to tune it.
